# Noto Sans SC assets

The project uses Noto Sans SC Regular (SIL Open Font License 1.1) for the device's embedded OTF and browser WOFF2 resources. The offline browser font shards derive from Fontsource Noto Sans SC 4.5.12. Exact shard URLs, coverage and SHA-256 values are recorded in `web/reader-cdn.json`; public mirror files are under `web/fonts/noto-sc-4.5.12/`.

Subset and format conversions do not relicense the fonts. Keep `OFL.txt` with font distributions and modified subsets. Noto is a trademark of Google; the font license does not apply to unrelated project code.
